checks_run: Inventoried the immutable candidate, parsed its manifest and provenance, and independently ran its self-contained pack audit.
Matched the submitted runtime.c and scheduler.c SHA-256 values to the controller-audited sources and inspected the slot/PID/context ownership path.
Cross-compiled an independent ARM reentrancy probe outside CANDIDATE and ran it under bounded QEMU 9.1.1.
Ran the submitted nominal ARM ELF under bounded QEMU, inspected its ELF headers and unresolved symbols, and performed a clean rebuild in a writable review copy.
Compiled and ran the sanitized 407-check reference suite, 12 adversarial vectors, public reference suite, and bounded-runner unit tests outside CANDIDATE.
Independently materialized and strictly audited both initial and post-attempt learner views.
Reviewed progressive disclosure, learner guidance, validation-label honesty, and license/provenance boundaries.
evidence: Submitted source hashes match the audit: runtime.c=4bcb6d4619a949e0a395168434db180bc1cc7d41b490cdb65a03c6f62527e919 and scheduler.c=8ba0e4915ed997dacb161212a7b423e927a01126b027621c927b0f0e802aab9c.

The independent QEMU probe emitted REENTRANT-PROBE, OUTER-RETURN, and BUG-STALE-RETURN-KILLED-REPLACEMENT; it omitted REPLACEMENT-RAN and NO-BUG. Raw UART was 68 bytes with SHA-256 08865798fa3b5544fdfc927e022f64c1d430e9d252feef2077185526f03ae7e7; CRLF-normalized output was 65 bytes with SHA-256 ab9b3fe67c8febba717d224c9c56d79529131bd50ab01051f5babca838bef62a.

runtime.c derives exit/yield ownership and context-save slots from mutable scheduler.current_slot; an outer physical frame can exit, reap, reuse, and select its own slot, then its stale return marks the replacement zombie before the replacement executes.

The 407-check reference suite and 12-vector adversarial suite passed, but their Makefiles omit runtime.c and arch/arm/context.S; the nominal ABABAB QEMU path performs no reentrant reap/reuse sequence.

A clean writable-copy rebuild produced byte-identical submitted artifacts: kernel.elf SHA-256 43dc67083d95cc6316da74f1811bacdd0da4d95c19cbc6244012d8fc70696d73 and kernel.bin SHA-256 b0a152b88f7f284512f82b46453ba20b6d44146841ffe240ea13c49b1b799021.

Strict materialized learner-view audits passed: initial 58 entries, digest c6f8db62ce0b4ef74cad2045fb59d42c7fdb76379a5cb20e7e14923b94e19f57; post-attempt 68 entries, digest 2745e745a78d8953aff4a481e2830e0a42946b90127a5b394366df83bc96e9bb. Both included LICENSE_BOUNDARY.md and no forbidden path component.
MANIFEST.yaml remains GENERATED/PARTIAL with independent validation REQUIRED and productionized false; no unsupported validation-label promotion was found.
limitations: No upstream checkout or network access was available, so independent authorship and the linked repository's license were not compared; only the candidate's internally consistent NOASSERTION boundary was reviewed.
The prior artifact tree was not supplied in this workspace, so the candidate's historical-preservation comparison was not independently repeated.
No physical ARM board, transfer environment, preemptive/userspace path, production workload, fuzz campaign, benchmark study, formal proof, or broad security audit was performed.
git and rg were unavailable in the sandbox; deterministic find, sed, SHA-256, and configured Python tooling were used instead.
